results.title: VPN connection drops frequently
results.description: The corporate VPN disconnects every few minutes or loses connection repeatedly.
results.resolution: Check internet stability, reconnect to the corporate VPN, and verify that the approved VPN client is updated. If the issue persists, escalate to the network support team.

results.title: Laptop running slowly
results.description: The employee's laptop performance is very slow, applications respond slowly, or the device freezes.
results.resolution: Restart the laptop, close unnecessary applications, and check available disk space. Contact IT support if the issue continues.
